title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Ct Value Microbial Nucleic Acid

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Ct value: Ct value — threshold number of a microbial nucleic acid', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Cycle threshold of a pathogen nucleic acid by any amplification technique. Parts: LOINC enumeration (40, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = 1268648001 |Threshold number (property) (qualifier value)|, 246093002 |Component (attribute)| = << 117174000 |Nucleic acid sequence with relative specificity for microorganism (substance)|`

purpose.value: Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated.
